answer: The vault graph is validated at intake and the voyage frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and terrace anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 21 dollars and 5 days per identity, which turns a 3686 account sybil into a 13 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
